articles.title: Investors explain early bets on Anthropic
articles.summary: Key financial backers share the core convictions that inspired them to invest billions of dollars into AI company Anthropic ahead of its expected initial public offering.

articles.title: Elizabeth Holmes documentary crosses $100M globally
articles.summary: A new documentary focusing on Elizabeth Holmes has generated over $100 million worldwide as it begins expanding into international markets.

articles.title: OpenAI chief scientist discusses AI growth limits
articles.summary: OpenAI's chief scientist argues that in order to implement a meaningful speed limit on artificial intelligence development, experts must first reach a consensus on how to measure that speed accurately.

articles.title: Top apps for making new friends
articles.summary: A compiled list of applications designed to help people form new connections, ranging from general friend-discovery platforms like BFF to event-focused options like Timeleft.

articles.title: Data centers drive Big Tech backlash
articles.summary: Journalist Paris Marx discusses the themes of his new book, Hyperscale, which explores why massive data centers have become a primary focal point for public criticism against major technology companies.

articles.title: TechCrunch Mobility explores robots versus humans
articles.summary: The latest edition of TechCrunch Mobility examines the future of transportation and the increasingly significant role that artificial intelligence plays in modern transit systems.

articles.title: Can a television be too large?
articles.summary: An author investigates the practical challenges and unexpected hurdles that come with upgrading to a massive 65-inch OLED television in a standard living space.

articles.title: Signal restricts screenshots to combat AI surveillance
articles.summary: Messaging platform Signal is limiting users' ability to capture screenshots on both Android and iOS applications as the company confronts what it describes as the existential threat of AI surveillance.

articles.title: Contrasting views emerge of chipmaker Nvidia
articles.summary: Recent reports present two very different images of Nvidia, contrasting the company's latest financial earnings report with tech executives publicly calling for CEO Jensen Huang's return.

articles.title: Trump calls reported FBI database hack concerning
articles.summary: Donald Trump has commented that a reported security breach of the National Crime Information Center database is concerning, while the FBI actively investigates the incident.

articles.title: Notable AI agents that integrate into text messages
articles.summary: A curated list highlights various artificial intelligence agents capable of operating directly within text messaging, including general assistants as well as specialized tools for families, travel, and work.

articles.title: Actor licenses digital face to microdrama startup
articles.summary: An actor has licensed an AI version of his face to a microdrama startup, reflecting a growing trend in China that raises questions about the long-term impacts if adopted in Hollywood.

articles.title: Kodak introduces tiny digital photo frame tracker
articles.summary: Reto is expanding its small hardware lineup with the Kodak SlideTag, a miniature digital photo frame that displays user pictures while doubling as a tracking device.

articles.title: Experts warn of future major tech outages
articles.summary: Following recent nationwide disruptions involving the FAA, Outlook, and JPMorgan Chase, experts including Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warn that more significant technological outages are likely ahead.

articles.title: Delta flights delayed in Atlanta due to system outage
articles.summary: Delta flights departing from and arriving at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport faced major delays on Sunday following a failure in the system responsible for calculating aircraft weight and balance.

articles.title: Developer removes AI music after Steam backlash
articles.summary: The developer of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus removed AI-generated music files containing Suno metadata from a Grand Theft Auto-themed section following heavy review-bombing on Steam.

articles.title: Black Friday discounts hit Nintendo Switch 2 games
articles.summary: Nintendo is offering Black Friday price cuts, reducing console bundle prices by $50 and knocking $20 off select Nintendo Switch 2 games to help shoppers expand their libraries.

articles.title: Sheherazaad releases folk-noir debut album Khudgarzi
articles.summary: Artist Sheherazaad has released her debut LP Khudgarzi, a genre-chaotic South Asian folk album sung primarily in Urdu that incorporates traditional Carnatic and Hindustani musical instrumentation.

articles.title: Protesters storm Meta offices in India
articles.summary: Members of India's opposition Congress party protested and entered Meta's Delhi offices, demanding the restoration of blocked accounts belonging to party leaders and threatening further demonstrations.

articles.title: Nintendo discounts Switch 2 console for Black Friday
articles.summary: Nintendo has reduced the price of one of its main console bundles by $50 for a limited time, with the discount running from late November through early December.

articles.title: Audience members test new theater headphones
articles.summary: Visitors attending a performance at the historic SoHo Playhouse in New York City were handed wired headphones connected to Auracast technology upon entering the theater.

articles.title: Looking back at the 1990s Tamagotchi craze
articles.summary: In the late 1990s, the Tamagotchi digital pet became an overnight phenomenon, captivating millions of children who took on the responsibility of feeding and caring for the virtual creature.

articles.title: GLP-1 drugs could significantly reduce agricultural land use
articles.summary: New estimates suggest that widespread use of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs could decrease food demand enough to free up an amount of global farmland larger than the entire country of Italy.

articles.title: Review praises sequel Godzilla Minus Zero
articles.summary: Director Takashi Yamazaki successfully raises the stakes in Godzilla Minus Zero by pitting the iconic monster against one of his most formidable historical opponents.

articles.title: Modern genetics refutes claims of racial intelligence differences
articles.summary: Scientific consensus and modern genetic research show that historical concepts of race realism lack factual support and fail to demonstrate any innate racial differences in human intelligence.

articles.title: FCC blocks California home phone service regulations
articles.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has preempted state-level regulations in California, ruling that the state cannot legally force companies like AT&T to continue offering traditional landline telephone service.

articles.title: SpaceX faces complications with Starshield in Ukraine
articles.summary: Recent operational troubles involving SpaceX's Starshield satellite service in Ukraine threaten to create broader complications for the company's lucrative military contracting business.

articles.title: Google updates search homepage to feature AI chat
articles.summary: Google has redesigned its search homepage to provide easier access to artificial intelligence tools, incorporating chat history directly onto the main page while removing the traditional search button.

articles.title: Meta reconsiders climate targets amid rising AI energy use
articles.summary: Driven by record-breaking energy consumption and emissions from its artificial intelligence data centers, Meta is actively re-evaluating its sustainability goals originally set for 2030.

articles.title: Data privacy experiment exposes supply chain vulnerabilities
articles.summary: A researcher embedded unique, trackable canary data into the artificial intelligence supply chain, discovering through prompts that sensitive information does not always remain private.

articles.title: Astronomers observe star swallowing neighboring star
articles.summary: A recent unexpected brightening in the night sky has been identified by astronomers as a stellar event caused by a star orbiting inside another before ultimately consuming it.

articles.title: NASA continues planning new lunar missions
articles.summary: NASA is progressing with its updated plans for returning to the Moon, though experts note that several major technical questions and debates still need to be resolved.

articles.title: Prisons permitted to use contraband phone jammers
articles.summary: While correctional facilities have received authorization to jam illegal contraband phones, telecommunications association CTIA warns that testing shows the signal disruption can affect nearby consumer phones up to 2.5 miles away.

articles.title: Army delays disposal of hazardous lead azide
articles.summary: The U.S. Army has delayed plans to detonate hazardous lead azide supplies due to public concern and safety models predicting that a toxic neurotoxic plume could travel up to 100 miles.

articles.title: Comparing Starlink pricing changes over time
articles.summary: Due to a combination of fluctuating rates, promotional discounts, and regional adjustments, different customers have experienced vastly different subscription costs for Starlink satellite internet services.

articles.title: How to clear the cache on Google TV
articles.summary: Clearing the storage cache on a Google TV is a helpful troubleshooting step to resolve performance glitches and software bugs, though it may not solve every system issue.
